description: Raw request volume (COUNT of rid) by category (L1/L2/L3) from the region-specific raw request log for one period.

request_volume.selector: COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.rid END), 0)
request_volume.description: Raw request-log row count (rid) for this category.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting__SP_REPORTING_DB_REGION__.os_product_ads_request_report AS r WHERE r.mcid = '__SP_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID__' AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.timestamp_utc), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND r.f_cat1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.f_cat1) != '' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
